verdict.rationale: Luma documents an agent-readable generation API: two endpoints, SDKs, llms.txt, markdown mirrors of every docs page, and per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions for the legacy create-generation call, plus a per-model credit price table. That covers submitting a prompt from docs and estimating cost, but the pack never documents polling job status, retrieving the finished asset, or the API reporting the actual cost of a job. The OpenAPI material also belongs to a generation the vendor labels legacy. Missing for 10: documented job-status polling or callbacks, asset download/URL retrieval, per-job cost reporting in API responses, OpenAPI coverage of the current Agents API, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
